description: This bar chart, from the paper “An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment of COVID-19 vaccines,” illustrates the distribution of tweets categorized by a numerical scale from 0 to 5, with the vertical axis labeled “Number of tweets” and scaled linearly from 0 to over 400,000, marked with major gridlines at intervals of 100,000. The horizontal axis represents the numerical categories (0 through 5), which are labeled below the x-axis and appear to be sorted in ascending order. The chart displays five vertical bars, each corresponding to one of these categories: the bar for category 0 is a very short, thin blue bar with a value of approximately 10,000; the bar for category 1 is a tall, wide brown bar reaching approximately 450,000; the bar for category 2 is a green bar reaching approximately 410,000; the bar for category 3 is a red bar reaching approximately 90,000; and the bar for category 4 is a very short, thin purple bar with a value of approximately 10,000. The bar for category 5 is not visible, indicating a value of zero or below the chart’s minimum display threshold. The bars are not grouped or stacked, and there is no legend provided to indicate what each color represents, although the colors appear to be distinct for each category. There is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar.
